Shanmukha Ramakrishna

Bangalore, India 560035 | +91 9715583829 krishnarama829@gmail.com

www: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shanmukha-ramakrish na-a18188158

Experienced data scientist with 7 years in developing data-intensive applications and addressing complex architectural and scalability challenges across various industries. Proficient in predictive modelling, data processing, and machine learning algorithms. Strong PySpark skills and a solid background in statistical analysis, enabling the derivation of actionable insights for informed decision-making and business growth, particularly in retail and finance sectors. Skilled in Python, and machine learning techniques. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and develop innovative solutions to complex business problems.

Work History

Decision Science Consultant Accenture, Bangalore

May 2025 - Current

Executed end-to-end data science projects, including data preparation, model development, and deployment.

Developed a migration pipeline from Databricks to GCP, worked on converting spark models into GCP Bigquery.

Managed monthly job scheduling and ongoing model maintenance to ensure optimal performance.

Led cross-functional teams in crafting data-driven strategies that improved client decision-making processes.

Facilitated communication between stakeholders to align project objectives with business goals.

Applied advanced statistical approaches to derive actionable insights from complex datasets.

Senior Applied Data Scientist Dunnhumby, Gurgaon, India

May 2023 - April 2025

Led a team of data scientists for a food client, developing multiple product combinations and a predictive model that significantly increased the digital customer base by 12% each month.

Developed a methodology to capture the top Products used by all the Loyal and Price Sensitive Customers and built the Key Value items of the client.

Developed Customer Lifetime Value model utilizing BTYD, Gamma-Gamma, Markov Chains, Regression, and Deep Learning techniques.

Created GenAI-based Text-to-SQL model employing GPT-4 for automated SQL query generation.

Conducted training sessions on Spark, Hadoop Ecosystem, Spark Ecosystem, and Spark Architecture, covering execution modes such as client and cluster mode.

Successfully pitched a comprehensive yearly plan to a client, resulting in a contract extension for an additional year.

Applied Data Scientist Dunnhumby, Gurgaon

October 2021 - April 2023

Developed a highly effective propensity model and customer acquisition model with an AUC score of 0.83, utilizing PCA for feature selection and Gradient Boosting for baseline modelling. Employed the Positive Unlabelled Learning (PU Bagging) approach for neural networks.

Created a customer lifecycle migration using loyalty segmentation to effectively score customers, providing detailed analysis on customer uplift, downgrade, and retention.

Developed scalable scripts and automated multiple processes, resulting in increased efficiency and reduced workload.

Contributed to the Omnichannel group project during the RPI Hackathon, focusing on the significance of customers in an

omnichannel setting.

Data Analyst

ATOS Syntel, Bangalore

July 2018 - September 2021

Designed Test and Control groups to check the impact of multiple campaigns and calculated their uplifts and significance of each test.

Designed a customer forecasting model using FB Prophet to predict customer trends for the upcoming year based on

historical data of 2 years.

Skills

PySpark,SQL, Python Machine Learning, Deep Learning Statistical Analysis, Predictive modelling Natural Language Processing Gen AI GCP, Databricks

Education

BTech in Electrical, Electronics And Communications Engineering May 2018 Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT University) at Vellore, India

Final CGPA : 8.02

Certifications

Advanced Pyspark

Machine learning and Deep learning masters at ineuron.ai

Data science A-Z: Real life Datascience
